# Oriel Fennvane

Oriel Fennvane is currently a Customs Clearance Analyst at Zorrel Analytics, a leader in advanced berth scheduling software that predicts optimal vessel docking times. Since joining Zorrel in 2021, Oriel has specialized in navigating complex international import-export regulations, ensuring compliance while minimizing delays in cargo processing.

Oriel’s career began in 2015 at Mariscan Logistics, where they supported container tracking operations and developed early frameworks for integrating customs data into shipment tracking. In 2018, Oriel joined Portline Services as a Regulatory Compliance Specialist, focusing on streamlining customs clearance protocols across multiple global ports. During this period, Oriel led the “Project Nautilus” initiative, designing a proprietary risk scoring model that enabled expedited customs processing for low-risk shipments, reducing average clearance time by 22%.

At Zorrel Analytics, Oriel has contributed to the “CraneSight” project, coordinating data integration between crane telemetry and customs documentation to improve real-time cargo status visibility. Oriel’s working style emphasizes meticulous regulation analysis combined with proactive collaboration; they regularly liaise with berth schedulers, crane operators, and customs officers to align operational priorities.

Known for clear communication and a data-driven approach, Oriel works closely with Zorrel’s software engineers and port operations managers to continuously refine customs workflows in alignment with evolving international trade regulations.
